gaps.sentence: She cheered ___ when she heard the news.
gaps.explanation: cheer up = become happier (also transitive: cheer somebody up).

gaps.sentence: I've mixed ___ the twins' names again.
gaps.explanation: mix up = confuse one thing/person with another.

gaps.sentence: I had to turn ___ their invitation because I was ill.
gaps.explanation: turn down = reject an offer/invitation; turn up = appear.

gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
She ___ down an offer from a rival university.
The old cinema was knocked ___ to build a car park.
gaps.explanation: knock down = demolish a building; hit with a vehicle.

gaps.sentence: Put ___ your coat — it's freezing outside.
gaps.explanation: put on = dress in; put off = postpone.

gaps.sentence: Can we narrow the list ___ to three names?
gaps.explanation: narrow down = reduce the number of possibilities.
